mentions.name: FormVoice
mentions.description: This tool provides simple, standalone feedback-gathering forms that can be integrated into any project, delivering submissions straight to the owner's inbox. It is optimized for coding agents' developer experience through full customization and data appending via URL parameters.
mentions.problem: Gathering user feedback across multiple projects is cumbersome without a simple, easily integrable standalone solution.
mentions.audience: Developers and coding agents who want to collect feedback across their projects.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just launched a little form-tool to integrate feedback gathering into all of my projects easily. Decided to make a standalone thing out of it.

As simple and personal as can be. Straight to inbox.

Optimized for coding agents DX  through full customization and data appending by url parameters.

https://formvoice.com
